select P.PRODUCT_NUMBER, P.NAME, P.DESCRIPTION, P.PRICE, P.QUANTITY, P.CREATED_DATE from PRODUCT_TB P WHERE 1=1
AND (P.PRODUCT_NUMBER LIKE '%' || #{searchInput} || '%' OR P.NAME LIKE '%' || #{searchInput} || '%')
AND P.PRODUCT_NUMBER IN ( SELECT M.PRODUCT_NUMBER FROM PRODUCT_CATEGORY_MAPPING_TB M JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY_TB C ON M.CATEGORY_ID = C.ID WHERE C.ID = #{category} )
AND P.PRODUCT_NUMBER IN ( SELECT S.PRODUCT_NUMBER FROM STOCK_TB S WHERE TRUNC(S.LAST_UPDATED) >= TO_DATE(#{last_fr_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') )
AND P.PRODUCT_NUMBER IN ( SELECT S.PRODUCT_NUMBER FROM STOCK_TB S WHERE TRUNC(S.LAST_UPDATED) <= TO_DATE(#{last_to_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') )
AND P.PRODUCT_NUMBER IN ( SELECT S.PRODUCT_NUMBER FROM STOCK_TB S WHERE S.QUANTITY >= #{stock_min} )
AND P.PRODUCT_NUMBER IN ( SELECT S.PRODUCT_NUMBER FROM STOCK_TB S WHERE S.QUANTITY <= #{stock_max} )

select S.ID, S.ADMIN_ID, S.PRODUCT_NUMBER, S.TITLE, S.DESCRIPTION, S.CREATED_DATE, S.LAST_POST_DATE, S.UPDATED_DATE, S.START_POST_DATE, S.STATUS from SALES_POST_TB S WHERE 1=1
AND (S.PRODUCT_NUMBER LIKE '%' || #{searchInput} || '%' OR S.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{searchInput} || '%')
AND S.PRODUCT_NUMBER IN ( SELECT S.PRODUCT_NUMBER FROM SALES_POST_TB S JOIN PRODUCT_TB P ON S.PRODUCT_NUMBER = P.PRODUCT_NUMBER WHERE P.QUANTITY >= #{stock_min} )
AND S.PRODUCT_NUMBER IN ( SELECT S.PRODUCT_NUMBER FROM SALES_POST_TB S JOIN PRODUCT_TB P ON S.PRODUCT_NUMBER = P.PRODUCT_NUMBER WHERE P.QUANTITY <= #{stock_max} )
AND S.PRODUCT_NUMBER IN ( SELECT S.PRODUCT_NUMBER FROM SALES_POST_TB S JOIN PRODUCT_TB P ON S.PRODUCT_NUMBER = P.PRODUCT_NUMBER WHERE P.PRICE >=#{price_min} )
AND S.PRODUCT_NUMBER IN ( SELECT S.PRODUCT_NUMBER FROM SALES_POST_TB S JOIN PRODUCT_TB P ON S.PRODUCT_NUMBER = P.PRODUCT_NUMBER WHERE P.PRICE <=#{price_max} )
AND TRUNC(S.LAST_POST_DATE) >= TO_DATE(#{last_fr_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TRUNC(S.LAST_POST_DATE) <= TO_DATE(#{last_to_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TRUNC(S.CREATED_DATE) >= TO_DATE(#{register_fr_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TRUNC(S.CREATED_DATE) <= TO_DATE(#{register_to_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND S.STATUS = #{sale_status}
